   `db:types` (kysely-codegen). TS strict, ESM, `module: NodeNext`.
2. Deps: fastify@5, @fastify/formbody, @fastify/multipart, @fastify/static, @fastify/secure-session, @fastify/flash,
   kysely, mysql2, nunjucks, bcryptjs, zod, dotenv, pusher, ioredis. Dev: typescript, tsx, vitest, kysely-codegen, @types/*.
3. `.env.example` + `.env` (gitignored) with: PORT=7000, APP_URL=http://localhost:7000, APP_TIMEZONE (copy from
   `~/code/office/config/app.php` timezone), APP_KEY (random 32 bytes hex, for secure-session), DB_HOST=127.0.0.1, DB_PORT=3306,
   DB_DATABASE=office, DB_USERNAME, DB_PASSWORD, DB_HWC_DATABASE=hwc, REDIS_HOST=127.0.0.1, REDIS_PORT=6379,
   PUBLIC_DIR=/home/johnny/code/office/public, OLD_APP_URL=http://localhost:6999, PARITY_EMAIL, PARITY_PASSWORD,
   SCHEDULER_ENABLED=0. Copy third-party API credentials from `~/code/office/.env` **only when a later task needs them**

title: Auth: login/logout/register/password reset, roles, PDA api-key
notes:
1. Sessions: @fastify/secure-session (key from APP_KEY, cookie `office_session`, httpOnly, sameSite lax) + @fastify/flash.
2. `src/auth.ts`: `currentUser(req)` loads `os_users` row (minus password/remember_token) + role names via
   `os_user_has_roles` ⨝ `os_roles` (cache on req). `hasRole(user, role|roles)`. Guard factory `requireRoles(roles)`:
   no user → 302 to `/login` (remember intended URL like Laravel `redirect()->guest`), user without any role → 403 body `No Access.`.
3. Routes from Laravel 5.4 `Route::auth()` (see vendor/laravel/framework/src/Illuminate/Routing/Router.php `auth()`):
   GET/POST /login, POST /logout, GET/POST /register, GET /password/reset, POST /password/email,
   GET /password/reset/{token}, POST /password/reset — with names login, logout, register, password.request,
   password.email, password.reset. Port views `auth/login`, `auth/register`, `auth/passwords/email`, `auth/passwords/reset`.
   Login field is `email` (AuthenticatesUsers default) — confirm in `app/Http/Controllers/Auth/LoginController.php`.
   Password check: bcryptjs.compare(plain, hash.replace(/^\$2y\$/, '$2a$')). On success redirect to intended or `/home`.
   Failed login: redirect back with `errors.email = trans('auth.failed')` and old input — same as Laravel.
   Laravel throttles login (5 tries/min) — replicate with an in-memory counter.
   Register / password reset: port behaviour (check RegisterController — it may be disabled/redirecting); password reset
   email sending must be behind a `MAIL_ENABLED` flag defaulting to off.
4. `pdaAuth` preHandler = port of `app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateApiKey.php` (Bearer / X-Api-Key / api_key input,
   sha256 → `os_user_api_tokens.token_hash`). Same 401 JSON bodies.
5. `auth:api` (api.php group: /api/logout, /api/user, /api/settings/profile, /api/settings/password, /api/pda/api-key):
   find out how the Vue bundle authenticates (grep `Authorization`, `access_token`, `localStorage` in
   `~/code/office/resources/assets/js`; check `config/auth.php` api guard driver — passport or jwt). Implement the same
   mechanism against the existing `os_oauth_*` tables / JWT secret so the existing compiled `public/js/app.js` keeps working.
   Document the decision in STATUS.md. If it's Passport personal tokens, validate by looking up the token id in
   `os_oauth_access_tokens` (JWT signed with `~/code/office/storage/oauth-public.key`).
6. `GET /`, `/home` → port HomeController@index role-based redirect logic (it's tiny) so login can be tested end-to-end.
Verify: tests for bcrypt $2y$ verification and role guard; manual: log in with PARITY_EMAIL on :7000.

title: Router helpers + parity harness
notes:
1. `src/router.ts`: `route(app, {verb, path, name, roles?, middleware?, handler})` where verb ∈ get|post|put|patch|delete|any;
   `resource(app, base, handlers, {roles, names})` (Laravel resource: index GET base, create GET base/create, store POST base,
   show GET base/{id}, edit GET base/{id}/edit, update PUT|PATCH base/{id}, destroy DELETE base/{id}; parameter name is
   the singular of base). Support `_method` spoofing: for POST requests whose body has `_method`, dispatch to the PUT/PATCH/DELETE
   handler (register POST base/:id for that). Optional params `{id?}` → register both variants. Laravel `{x}` → `:x`.
   Keep a named-route registry; `routeUrl(name, params)` builds absolute URLs like Laravel `route()` (extra params → query string).
   Wire `route()` in view.ts to it.
2. Not-found fallback (`setNotFoundHandler`): replicate Laravel's regex catch-alls in original order (see
   `plan/inventory.json` routes with `where` set): `/{Supplier?}` where `[\/Supplier\.-]*` (roles admin,user,supplier) →
   SupplierProduct@index; then `/{ListProducts?}`, `/{InventoryCount?}`, `/{InventoryConsolidation?}`, `/{Orders?}` (roles
   admin,user,remote) → Product@vue. Handlers are registered later by T26/T30 via `registerFallback(name, handler)`;
   until then return Laravel's 404 page. Unmatched → Laravel 404 view (`views/errors/404.njk` if it exists, else Laravel's default).
3. `src/http.ts`: input(req,k), allInput(req), redirectBack(req, reply) (uses Referer like Laravel), withErrors, withInput,
   paginate(query, perPage, req) returning Laravel 5.4 LengthAwarePaginator JSON shape.
4. `scripts/parity.ts`: `pnpm parity --task T10` reads `plan/parity-routes.json[T10]`; or `--urls /a,/b`. Logs into OLD_APP_URL
   (GET /login → read `_token` + laravel_session cookie → POST /login) and the new app (POST /login) with
   PARITY_EMAIL/PARITY_PASSWORD; fetches each URL from both with `redirect: 'manual'`; compares status, Location header,
   and body. HTML normalize: collapse whitespace, strip `_token` values / csrf meta, strip APP_URL host differences
   (old vs new base URL), strip `?id=<mix hash>`. JSON: deep-equal after parse. Prints a unified diff (first 80 lines) per
   failing URL; exit 1 if any fail. Also writes full outputs to `.parity/<task>/`.
5. Start the old app if it isn't running: document the exact docker command in `plan/RUNBOOK.md` (from
   `~/code/office/docker-run-readme.md`; MySQL and Redis are docker containers `mysql` and `redis` on network `stack_default`).
Verify: `pnpm parity --urls /home,/login` passes (after logging in both).

title: Shared helpers: DataTables, Pusher, mail, storage, excel
notes:
Only build what modules need; each helper gets a unit test.
1. `src/datatables.ts`: yajra/laravel-datatables-oracle **v6** server-side protocol for a Kysely query: read draw, start,
   length, search[value], order[i][column|dir], columns[i][data|name|searchable|orderable]; global search = OR LIKE
   %v% over searchable columns; per-column search; response `{draw, recordsTotal, recordsFiltered, data}` with the same
   key order and types as yajra v6. Support `editColumn`/`addColumn` callbacks. Read the yajra v6 source in
   `~/code/office/vendor/yajra` to match edge cases (e.g. length -1 = all).
   Also port `app/Libraries/DatatablesEditor.php` if it's used by Inventory (check) → `src/lib/datatables-editor.ts`.
2. `src/pusher.ts`: thin wrapper reading PUSHER_* (copy names from old .env) — `trigger(channel, event, data)`.
3. `src/mail.ts`: nodemailer from MAIL_* env, **no-op + log unless MAIL_ENABLED=1**.
4. `src/storage.ts`: local disk (PUBLIC_DIR, storage path) + S3 (@aws-sdk/client-s3) mirroring `config/filesystems.php` disks used by the app.
5. `src/excel.ts`: exceljs helpers to produce xlsx/csv downloads matching maatwebsite/excel 2.1 output used by the app
   (grep `Excel::create` / `Excel::load` to see which features are used).
6. `src/images.ts`: sharp-based equivalents of the Intervention calls used (grep `Image::make`).

4. Port `app/Jobs/*` (MassPrintLabel, AmzMassPrintLabel, FrayunMassPrintLabel, DownloadLabel, QueuePing) as BullMQ jobs, and
